audit_metadata.scope: Full repository audit: security, reliability, performance, UX
audit_metadata.methodology: Line-by-line code review, grep analysis, runtime simulation

findings.title: secrets.env committed to git history
findings.description: Secrets file containing 5 API keys was committed to main branch on Sept 10, 2025. Keys exposed in git history. NOTE: Repository is PRIVATE/PERSONAL, so this is a best-practice issue, NOT a security emergency. No key rotation required.
findings.impact: LOW - Repository is private/personal use. Keys are safe. Violates best practices but no external exposure risk.
findings.expected: secrets.env never committed to version control
findings.actual: secrets.env committed Sept 10, visible in git history
findings.fix_hint: OPTIONAL: 1. Clean git history with BFG Repo-Cleaner (if you want pristine log). 2. Add detect-secrets pre-commit hook (prevent future leaks). Key rotation NOT required for private repo.

findings.title: Debug endpoints lack authentication
findings.description: Three debug endpoints (/debug/telegram_test, /debug/prev_close, /debug/price_diag) do not require bearer token authentication, allowing unauthenticated access to internal diagnostics and external API calls.
findings.impact: MEDIUM - Attackers can trigger external API calls, exhaust rate limits, view internal state
findings.likelihood: HIGH - Endpoints publicly accessible if server exposed
findings.expected: All write/debug endpoints require valid bearer token
findings.fix_hint: Add `credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(AUTH_DEP)` parameter to each endpoint. Call `_require_bearer(credentials)` at start of function. Add test_debug_auth.py to verify 401 on missing token.

findings.title: Duplicate /api/cockpit/stream endpoint definitions
findings.description: The /api/cockpit/stream endpoint is defined twice in wolf_app.py, causing undefined behavior (last registration wins). Duplicate routes are a symptom of refactoring debt.
findings.impact: MEDIUM - Unpredictable behavior, one implementation shadows the other
repro_steps: Observe two matches: line 4442 and line 6182
Test SSE endpoint: verify which implementation executes (likely second one)
findings.fix_hint: Consolidate to single /api/cockpit/stream implementation. Choose the more recent/feature-complete version. Add test: grep all @APP.get/@APP.post decorators, assert no duplicates. Verify SSE stream works after consolidation.

findings.title: SSE generators lack client disconnect detection and TTL
findings.description: Three SSE generator functions (lines 4406, 4442, 6182) run infinite loops without checking if client disconnected. This causes memory leaks and resource exhaustion as disconnected clients are never cleaned up.
findings.impact: MEDIUM - Memory leaks, CPU waste, potential OOM crash
findings.likelihood: HIGH - Every disconnected SSE client leaks resources
repro_steps: Open cockpit page in browser (starts SSE connection)
Close browser tab without closing SSE gracefully
Observe memory usage grows, generators never stop
findings.expected: SSE generators detect client disconnect and exit loop
findings.actual: Generators run forever even after client gone
findings.fix_hint: Add `if await request.is_disconnected(): break` check inside each SSE loop. Alternatively, add 5-minute TTL: exit after timeout. Add Prometheus gauge: active_sse_connections. Test: start SSE → kill client → verify generator exits.

findings.title: Yahoo 429 backoff lacks jitter and cooldown reset
findings.description: Circuit breaker _breaker_on_success() (line 2555) resets state and failures but does NOT reset backoff_factor to 0. After 3x 429 errors (backoff_factor=3 → 240s backoff), a single success closes circuit but keeps backoff_factor=3. Next failure immediately triggers 240s backoff instead of restarting at 30s. Also lacks jitter, causing thundering herd on recovery.
findings.impact: HIGH - Permanent degraded performance after transient 429, provider locked in max-backoff forever
findings.likelihood: MEDIUM - Occurs during Yahoo API rate limit spikes
repro_steps: Trigger 3x 429 errors from Yahoo (backoff increases to 240s)
Wait for circuit to close after timeout
Make successful request (circuit closes, backoff_factor stays 3)
Observe: backoff immediately jumps to 240s instead of 30s
findings.expected: Success resets backoff_factor to 0, next failure starts at 30s
findings.actual: Success leaves backoff_factor sticky, next failure uses stale high backoff
findings.fix_hint: In _breaker_on_success() add: `b['backoff_factor'] = 0`. In _breaker_on_failure() add jitter: `backoff = backoff * (1 + random.uniform(-0.2, 0.2))`. Add unit test: simulate 429 → success → 429 → assert backoff resets.

findings.title: Reuters DNS failures cause hard crash with no degraded mode
findings.description: Reuters feed parsing loop (line 3058-3110) has try/except per feed URL but no outer wrapper. DNS resolution failure or network timeout propagates up, crashes entire news refresh, sets NEWS_CACHE['items'] = [], causing UI to show blank news section.
findings.impact: MEDIUM - Empty news UI on transient DNS failure, no graceful degradation
findings.likelihood: MEDIUM - DNS failures occur periodically (ISP issues, Railway network)
findings.expected: DNS failure returns last-good cached news with _degraded flag
findings.actual: DNS failure crashes loop, clears cache, blank UI
findings.fix_hint: Wrap entire `if REUTERS_FEEDS_ON:` block in outer try/except. On exception: log error, return NEWS_CACHE['items'] from previous refresh with `'_degraded': True`. Add last_refresh_ts to track staleness. Test: kill DNS → verify UI shows cached news.

findings.title: Telegram webhook validation missing signature check
findings.description: Telegram webhook endpoint /telegram/webhook (line 5940) does not validate X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header. Attackers can forge webhook calls to trigger bot commands without Telegram authentication.
findings.impact: MEDIUM - Unauthenticated command execution via forged webhooks
findings.likelihood: LOW - Requires knowledge of webhook URL
repro_steps: Observe: webhook processes command without signature validation
findings.fix_hint: 1. Generate secret: `openssl rand -base64 32`, store in TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var. 2. In webhook endpoint: `secret = request.headers.get('X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token'); if secret != TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET: raise HTTPException(403)`. 3. Configure secret in Telegram API when setting webhook URL.

findings.title: Legacy main.py duplicates routes from wolf_app.py
findings.description: main.py (1370 lines) contains old FastAPI app with duplicate routes (e.g., /api/cockpit). This file is no longer used (wolf_app.py is entry point) but causes confusion and maintenance burden.
findings.impact: LOW - Confusing codebase, risk of editing wrong file
findings.likelihood: MEDIUM - Developers may edit main.py thinking it's active
repro_steps: Observe both files define FastAPI routes
Check Dockerfile/Railway start command: uses wolf_app.py
findings.expected: Single source of truth for application routes
findings.actual: Two files with overlapping routes, main.py unused
findings.fix_hint: Rename main.py to main_DEPRECATED.py. Add header comment: 'This file is deprecated. Use wolf_app.py.' Run tests to verify no imports reference main.py. Document migration in CHANGELOG.md.

findings.title: 100+ environment variables lack centralized documentation
findings.description: GHOST uses 100+ environment variables for configuration (price providers, toggles, API keys, thresholds). No single reference document exists. Developers must grep code to discover variables.
findings.impact: LOW - Developer friction, hard to onboard new contributors
findings.likelihood: HIGH - Every new developer struggles with config
findings.expected: Centralized ENV_VARS_REFERENCE.md with all variables documented
findings.actual: No reference doc, variables scattered across code
findings.fix_hint: Create ENV_VARS_REFERENCE.md. Sections: Price Providers, News Feeds, Persistence, Telegram, Monitoring, Feature Toggles, Thresholds. For each var: name, type, default, description, example. Add link from README.md.

findings.title: Forecast accuracy metrics not exposed to UI
findings.description: Backend computes MAP and RMSE forecast accuracy (line 755 _compute_forecast_accuracy), and _build_two_line_forecast (line 801) calls it. However, /api/cockpit endpoint uses _forecast_summary_for_snapshot() which does NOT include accuracy metrics. UI cannot display accuracy chips.
findings.impact: LOW - Missing useful user-facing metric, reduces transparency
findings.likelihood: HIGH - Always missing from API response
repro_steps: Observe forecast object: no 'accuracy' or 'mape' or 'rmse' fields
Check UI: no accuracy chips displayed
findings.actual: Accuracy computed in backend but not returned in API
findings.fix_hint: Option 1: In _build_cockpit_snapshot(), add `snapshot['forecast_accuracy'] = two_line['accuracy']['summary']`. Option 2: Modify _forecast_summary_for_snapshot() to call _compute_forecast_accuracy() and include result. Update UI to display chips: 'MAPE: 2.3%', 'RMSE: $45.67'.

findings.title: /health/detailed latency spikes >5s under DB write load
findings.description: /health/detailed endpoint (line 4189) performs synchronous SQLite queries (sqlite3.connect(), cur.execute(), conn.commit()) without timeout guards. Under write contention, SQLite locks cause healthcheck to block >5 seconds, triggering Railway timeout → pod restart loop.
findings.impact: MEDIUM - Railway healthcheck timeout causes pod restarts, downtime
findings.likelihood: LOW - Only under sustained write load
repro_steps: Start server with autosave enabled (writes every 30s)
Simultaneously: run 100 concurrent write requests to /api/trade
Observe: 5-10 second latency due to SQLite lock contention
findings.actual: Latency spikes >5s, Railway times out, pod restarts
findings.fix_hint: Option 1: Wrap DB checks in `asyncio.wait_for(check_db(), timeout=3.0)`, catch TimeoutError. Option 2: Separate /live (fast, no DB) and /ready (DB checks) probes. Railway uses /live for liveness, /ready for readiness. Option 3: Enable SQLite WAL mode to reduce lock contention.
